original_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0 and let Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) denote the subgroup of polynomial automorphisms of k[x1, ..., xn] with Jacobian determinant 1. A subgroup G of Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) is called ∂-generated if there exists a set Gcal of locally nilpotent derivations of k[x1, ..., xn] such that G is generated by the automorphisms exp(D) with D in Gcal; it is called finitely ∂-generated if there exists a finite set Gcal such that G is generated by all automorphisms exp(fD) with D in Gcal and f in Ker(D). Is the full group Aut*_k(k[x1, ..., xn]) ∂-generated? If it is, is it finitely ∂-generated?
correct_elements: Your draft already captures Popov's §2 open problem essentially verbatim: it uses the correct ambient group Aut*_k(k[x_1,...,x_n]), the correct field hypothesis, and the same two notions of ∂-generated and finitely ∂-generated that immediately precede Problem 2.1 in the paper.
missing_details: Make the quantifier on n explicit. In §2 the question is posed for the full group Aut*_k k[n], and the nearby examples then record affirmative cases for n=1 and n=2.
Define 'locally nilpotent derivation' explicitly: a k-derivation D of k[n] such that for every h in k[n] there exists m=m(h) with D^m(h)=0.
State the paper's shorthand k[n]:=k[x_1,...,x_n] and the Jacobian-one condition as det((∂σ(x_j)/∂x_i)_{1<=i,j<=n})=1.

For finite ∂-generation, emphasize that one fixes finitely many locally nilpotent derivations D and allows all exponentials exp(fD) with f in Ker(D), using the fact recalled in §2 that fD is again locally nilpotent when f is in Ker(D).

If you want the paper-faithful research context, mention that Examples 2.4 and 2.5 already give finite ∂-generation for Aut*_k k[1] and Aut*_k k[2], and Remark 2.1 observes that the wild Nagata automorphism is still of the form exp(fD).
refined_question: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0, let k[n]:=k[x_1,...,x_n], and let Aut*_k k[n]:={σ in Aut_k k[n] | det((∂σ(x_j)/∂x_i)_{1<=i,j<=n})=1}. A k-derivation D of k[n] is called locally nilpotent if for every h in k[n] there exists m=m(h) such that D^m(h)=0. A subgroup G of Aut*_k k[n] is called ∂-generated if there exists a set 𝒢 of locally nilpotent derivations of k[n] such that G is generated by the automorphisms exp(D) with D in 𝒢; it is called finitely ∂-generated if there exists a finite set 𝒢 of locally nilpotent derivations such that G is generated by all exp(fD) with D in 𝒢 and f in Ker(D). For each integer n>=1, is the full volume-preserving affine Cremona group Aut*_k k[n] ∂-generated? If so, is it finitely ∂-generated?
justification: This is the exact open problem asked in §2, Problem 2.1. The definitions immediately before it are precisely the notions of ∂-generated and finitely ∂-generated that your draft is using, and the same page supplies the intended nearby context: semisimple subgroups, translations, and de Jonquière groups are finitely ∂-generated; Aut*_k k[1] and Aut*_k k[2] are also finitely ∂-generated; and even the wild Nagata automorphism is exhibited as exp(fD). So the draft is already very close to the paper, and the main refinement is just to make the setup fully self-contained and explicit in the paper's notation.
